    14	module prim_fifo_sync #(
    15	  parameter int unsigned Width       = 16,
    16	  parameter bit Pass                 = 1'b1, // if == 1 allow requests to pass through empty FIFO
    17	  parameter int unsigned Depth       = 4,
    18	  parameter bit OutputZeroIfEmpty    = 1'b1, // if == 1 always output 0 when FIFO is empty
    19	  parameter bit NeverClears          = 1'b0, // if set, the clr_i port is never high
    20	  parameter bit Secure               = 1'b0, // use prim count for pointers
    21	  // derived parameter
    22	  localparam int          DepthW     = prim_util_pkg::vbits(Depth+1)
    23	) (
    24	  input                   clk_i,
    25	  input                   rst_ni,
    26	  // synchronous clear / flush port
    27	  input                   clr_i,
    28	  // write port
    29	  input                   wvalid_i,
    30	  output                  wready_o,
    31	  input   [Width-1:0]     wdata_i,
    32	  // read port
    33	  output                  rvalid_o,
    34	  input                   rready_i,
    35	  output  [Width-1:0]     rdata_o,
    36	  // occupancy
    37	  output                  full_o,
    38	  output  [DepthW-1:0]    depth_o,
    39	  output                  err_o

    42	
    43	  // FIFO is in complete passthrough mode
    44	  if (Depth == 0) begin : gen_passthru_fifo
    45	    `ASSERT_INIT(paramCheckPass, Pass == 1)

    47	    assign depth_o = 1'b0; //output is meaningless
    48	
    49	    // device facing
    50	    assign rvalid_o = wvalid_i;
    51	    assign rdata_o = wdata_i;
    52	
    53	    // host facing
    54	    assign wready_o = rready_i;
    55	    assign full_o = 1'b1;
    56	
    57	    // this avoids lint warnings
    58	    logic unused_clr;
    59	    assign unused_clr = clr_i;
    60	
    61	    // No error
    62	    assign err_o = 1'b 0;
    63	
    64	  // FIFO has space for a single element (and doesn't need proper counters)
    65	  end else if (Depth == 1) begin : gen_singleton_fifo

    68	    logic full_d, full_q;

    70	    assign full_o = full_q;
    71	    assign depth_o = full_q;
    72	    assign wready_o = ~full_q;

    81	    //

    88	      end else begin
    89	        full_q <= full_d;
    90	      end
    91	    end
    92	
    93	    logic [Width-1:0] storage;

   115	      prim_flop #(
   116	        .Width(1),
   117	        .ResetValue(1'b1)
   118	      ) u_inv_full (
   119	        .clk_i,
   120	        .rst_ni,
   121	        .d_i (~full_d),
   122	        .q_o (inv_full)

   131	        end else begin
   132	          err_q <= err_d;
   133	        end
   134	      end

   136	      assign err_o = err_q;

   140	  end else begin : gen_normal_fifo
   141	
   142	    localparam int unsigned PtrW = prim_util_pkg::vbits(Depth);
   143	
   144	    logic [PtrW-1:0] fifo_wptr, fifo_rptr;
   145	    logic            fifo_incr_wptr, fifo_incr_rptr, fifo_empty;

   147	    // module under reset flag

   152	      end else if (under_rst) begin

   154	      end
   155	    end

   157	    logic empty;

   162	    assign wready_o = ~full_o & ~under_rst;

   164	    prim_fifo_sync_cnt #(
   165	      .Depth(Depth),
   166	      .Secure(Secure),
   167	      .NeverClears(NeverClears)
   168	    ) u_fifo_cnt (
   169	      .clk_i,
   170	      .rst_ni,
   171	      .clr_i,
   172	      .incr_wptr_i(fifo_incr_wptr),
   173	      .incr_rptr_i(fifo_incr_rptr),
   174	      .wptr_o(fifo_wptr),
   175	      .rptr_o(fifo_rptr),
   176	      .full_o,
   177	      .empty_o(fifo_empty),
   178	      .depth_o,
   179	      .err_o
   180	    );
   181	    assign fifo_incr_wptr = wvalid_i & wready_o;
   182	    assign fifo_incr_rptr = rvalid_o & rready_i & ~under_rst;
   183	
   184	    logic [Depth-1:0][Width-1:0] storage;
   185	    logic [Width-1:0] storage_rdata;
   186	
   187	    assign storage_rdata = storage[fifo_rptr];
   188	
   189	    always_ff @(posedge clk_i)
   190	      if (fifo_incr_wptr) begin
   191	        storage[fifo_wptr] <= wdata_i;
   192	      end
   193	
   194	    logic [Width-1:0] rdata_int;
   195	    if (Pass == 1'b1) begin : gen_pass
   196	      assign rdata_int = (fifo_empty && wvalid_i) ? wdata_i : storage_rdata;
   197	      assign empty = fifo_empty & ~wvalid_i;
   198	      assign rvalid_o = ~empty & ~under_rst;
   199	    end else begin : gen_nopass
   200	      assign rdata_int = storage_rdata;
   201	      assign empty = fifo_empty;
   202	      assign rvalid_o = ~empty;
   203	    end
   204	
   205	    if (OutputZeroIfEmpty == 1'b1) begin : gen_output_zero
   206	      assign rdata_o = empty ? Width'(0) : rdata_int;
   207	    end else begin : gen_no_output_zero
   208	      assign rdata_o = rdata_int;
   209	    end

   211	    `ASSERT(depthShallNotExceedParamDepth, !empty |-> depth_o <= DepthW'(Depth))
   212	    `ASSERT(OnlyRvalidWhenNotUnderRst_A, rvalid_o -> ~under_rst)
   213	  end // block: gen_normal_fifo
   214	
   215	
   216	  if (NeverClears) begin : gen_never_clears
   217	    `ASSERT(NeverClears_A, !clr_i)
   218	  end

   221	  // Known Assertions //
   222	  //////////////////////
   223	
   224	  `ASSERT_KNOWN_IF(DataKnown_A, rdata_o, rvalid_o)
   225	  `ASSERT_KNOWN(DepthKnown_A, depth_o)
   226	  `ASSERT_KNOWN(RvalidKnown_A, rvalid_o)
   227	  `ASSERT_KNOWN(WreadyKnown_A, wready_o)

    50	  input rst_ni,
    51	  input clr_i,
    52	  input set_i,
    53	  input [Width-1:0] set_cnt_i,                 // Set value for the counter.
    54	  input incr_en_i,
    55	  input decr_en_i,
    56	  input [Width-1:0] step_i,                    // Increment/decrement step when enabled.

    81	`endif

    86	    logic [Width-1:0] set_val;

    89	      assign decr_en = decr_en_i;
    90	      assign set_val = set_cnt_i;
    91	    end else begin : gen_dn_cnt

    95	      assign set_val = {Width{1'b1}} - set_cnt_i;
    96	    end

    98	    // Main counter logic

   113	    logic cnt_en;

   128	      .ResetValue(ResetValues[k])

   131	      .rst_ni,

    44	module prim_packer_fifo #(
    45	  parameter int InW  = 32,
    46	  parameter int OutW = 8,
    47	  parameter bit ClearOnRead = 1'b1, // if == 1 always output 0 after read
    48	  // derived parameters
    49	  localparam int MaxW = (InW > OutW) ? InW : OutW,
    50	  localparam int MinW = (InW < OutW) ? InW : OutW,
    51	  localparam int DepthW = $clog2(MaxW/MinW)
    52	) (
    53	  input logic clk_i ,
    54	  input logic rst_ni,
    55	
    56	  input logic               clr_i,
    57	  input logic               wvalid_i,
    58	  input logic  [InW-1:0]    wdata_i,
    59	  output logic              wready_o,
    60	
    61	  output logic              rvalid_o,
    62	  output logic [OutW-1:0]   rdata_o,
    63	  input logic               rready_i,
    64	  output logic [DepthW:0]   depth_o
    65	);
    66	
    67	  localparam int unsigned   WidthRatio = MaxW / MinW;
    68	  localparam bit [DepthW:0] FullDepth = WidthRatio[DepthW:0];
    69	  localparam bit [DepthW:0] DepthOne = 1;
    70	
    71	  // signals
    72	  logic  load_data;
    73	  logic  clear_data;
    74	  logic  clear_status;
    75	
    76	  // flops
    77	  logic [DepthW:0] depth_q, depth_d;
    78	  logic [MaxW-1:0] data_q, data_d;
    79	  logic            clr_q, clr_d;
    80	
    81	  always_ff @(posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni) begin
    82	    if (!rst_ni) begin
    83	      depth_q <= '0;
    84	      data_q  <= '0;
    85	      clr_q   <= 1'b1;
    86	    end else begin
    87	      depth_q <= depth_d;
    88	      data_q  <= data_d;
    89	      clr_q   <= clr_d;
    90	    end
    91	  end
    92	
    93	  // flop for handling reset case for clr
    94	  assign clr_d = clr_i;
    95	
    96	  assign depth_o = depth_q;
    97	
    98	  if (InW < OutW) begin : gen_pack_mode
    99	    logic [MaxW-1:0] wdata_shifted;
   100	
   101	    assign wdata_shifted = {{OutW - InW{1'b0}}, wdata_i} << (depth_q*InW);
   102	    assign clear_status = (rready_i && rvalid_o) || clr_q;
   103	    assign clear_data = (ClearOnRead && clear_status) || clr_q;
   104	    assign load_data = wvalid_i && wready_o;
   105	
   106	    assign depth_d =  clear_status ? '0 :
   107	           load_data ? (depth_q + DepthOne):
   108	           depth_q;
   109	
   110	    assign data_d = clear_data ? '0 :
   111	           load_data ? (wdata_shifted | (depth_q == 0 ? '0 : data_q)) :
   112	           data_q;
   113	
   114	    // set outputs
   115	    assign wready_o = !(depth_q == FullDepth) && !clr_q;
   116	    assign rdata_o =  data_q;
   117	    assign rvalid_o = (depth_q == FullDepth) && !clr_q;
   118	
   119	  end else begin : gen_unpack_mode
   120	    logic [MaxW-1:0] rdata_shifted;
   121	    logic            pull_data;
   122	    logic [DepthW:0] ptr_q, ptr_d;
   123	    logic [DepthW:0] lsb_is_one;
   124	    logic [DepthW:0] max_value;
   125	
   126	    always_ff @(posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni) begin
   127	      if (!rst_ni) begin
   128	        ptr_q   <= '0;
   129	      end else begin
   130	        ptr_q   <= ptr_d;
   131	      end
   132	    end
   133	
   134	    assign lsb_is_one = {{DepthW{1'b0}},1'b1};
   135	    assign max_value = FullDepth;
   136	    assign rdata_shifted = data_q >> ptr_q*OutW;
   137	    assign clear_status = (rready_i && (depth_q == lsb_is_one)) || clr_q;
   138	    assign clear_data = (ClearOnRead && clear_status) || clr_q;
   139	    assign load_data = wvalid_i && wready_o;
   140	    assign pull_data = rvalid_o && rready_i;
   141	
   142	    assign depth_d =  clear_status ? '0 :
   143	           load_data ? max_value :
   144	           pull_data ? (depth_q - DepthOne) :
   145	           depth_q;
   146	
   147	    assign ptr_d =  clear_status ? '0 :
   148	           pull_data ? (ptr_q + DepthOne) :
   149	           ptr_q;
   150	
   151	    assign data_d = clear_data ? '0 :
   152	           load_data ? wdata_i :
   153	           data_q;
   154	
   155	    // set outputs
   156	    assign wready_o = (depth_q == '0) && !clr_q;
   157	    assign rdata_o =  rdata_shifted[OutW-1:0];
   158	    assign rvalid_o = !(depth_q == '0) && !clr_q;
   159	
   160	    // Avoid possible lint errors in case InW > OutW.
   161	    if (InW > OutW) begin : gen_unused
   162	      logic [MaxW-MinW-1:0] unused_rdata_shifted;
   163	      assign unused_rdata_shifted = rdata_shifted[MaxW-1:MinW];
   164	    end
   165	  end
   166

   169	  // Assertions, Assumptions, and Coverpoints //
   170	  //////////////////////////////////////////////
   171	
   172	  // If not acked, valid_o should keep asserting
   173	  `ASSERT(ValidOPairedWithReadyI_A,
   174	          rvalid_o && !rready_i && !clr_i |=> rvalid_o)
   175	
   176	  // If output port doesn't accept the data, the data should be stable
   177	  `ASSERT(DataOStableWhenPending_A,
   178	          ##1 rvalid_o && $past(rvalid_o)
   179	          && !$past(rready_i) && !$past(clr_i) |-> $stable(rdata_o))
   180

    42	    logic gate_clock;
    43	    // pointer to the read and write section of the queue
    44	    logic [ADDR_DEPTH - 1:0] read_pointer_n, read_pointer_q, write_pointer_n, write_pointer_q;
    45	    // keep a counter to keep track of the current queue status
    46	    // this integer will be truncated by the synthesis tool
    47	    logic [ADDR_DEPTH:0] status_cnt_n, status_cnt_q;
    48	    // actual memory
    49	    dtype [FifoDepth - 1:0] mem_n, mem_q;
    50	
    51	    assign usage_o = status_cnt_q[ADDR_DEPTH-1:0];
    52	
    53	    if (DEPTH == 0) begin : gen_pass_through
    54	        assign empty_o     = ~push_i;
    55	        assign full_o      = ~pop_i;
    56	    end else begin : gen_fifo
    57	        assign full_o       = (status_cnt_q == FifoDepth[ADDR_DEPTH:0]);
    58	        assign empty_o      = (status_cnt_q == 0) & ~(FALL_THROUGH & push_i);
    59	    end
    60	    // status flags
    61	
    62	    // read and write queue logic
    63	    always_comb begin : read_write_comb
    64	        // default assignment
    65	        read_pointer_n  = read_pointer_q;
    66	        write_pointer_n = write_pointer_q;
    67	        status_cnt_n    = status_cnt_q;
    68	        data_o          = (DEPTH == 0) ? data_i : mem_q[read_pointer_q];
    69	        mem_n           = mem_q;
    70	        gate_clock      = 1'b1;
    71	
    72	        // push a new element to the queue
    73	        if (push_i && ~full_o) begin
    74	            // push the data onto the queue
    75	            mem_n[write_pointer_q] = data_i;
    76	            // un-gate the clock, we want to write something
    77	            gate_clock = 1'b0;
    78	            // increment the write counter
    79	            // this is dead code when DEPTH is a power of two
    80	            if (write_pointer_q == FifoDepth[ADDR_DEPTH-1:0] - 1)
    81	                write_pointer_n = '0;
    82	            else
    83	                write_pointer_n = write_pointer_q + 1;
    84	            // increment the overall counter
    85	            status_cnt_n    = status_cnt_q + 1;
    86	        end
    87	
    88	        if (pop_i && ~empty_o) begin
    89	            // read from the queue is a default assignment
    90	            // but increment the read pointer...
    91	            // this is dead code when DEPTH is a power of two
    92	            if (read_pointer_n == FifoDepth[ADDR_DEPTH-1:0] - 1)
    93	                read_pointer_n = '0;
    94	            else
    95	                read_pointer_n = read_pointer_q + 1;
    96	            // ... and decrement the overall count
    97	            status_cnt_n   = status_cnt_q - 1;
    98	        end
    99	
   100	        // keep the count pointer stable if we push and pop at the same time
   101	        if (push_i && pop_i &&  ~full_o && ~empty_o)
   102	            status_cnt_n   = status_cnt_q;
   103	
   104	        // FIFO is in pass through mode -> do not change the pointers
   105	        if (FALL_THROUGH && (status_cnt_q == 0) && push_i) begin
   106	            data_o = data_i;
   107	            if (pop_i) begin
   108	                status_cnt_n = status_cnt_q;
   109	                read_pointer_n = read_pointer_q;
   110	                write_pointer_n = write_pointer_q;
   111	            end
   112	        end
   113	    end
   114	
   115	    // sequential process
   116	    always_ff @(posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni) begin
   117	        if(~rst_ni) begin
   118	            read_pointer_q  <= '0;
   119	            write_pointer_q <= '0;
   120	            status_cnt_q    <= '0;
   121	        end else begin
   122	            if (flush_i) begin
   123	                read_pointer_q  <= '0;
   124	                write_pointer_q <= '0;
   125	                status_cnt_q    <= '0;
   126	             end else begin
   127	                read_pointer_q  <= read_pointer_n;
   128	                write_pointer_q <= write_pointer_n;
   129	                status_cnt_q    <= status_cnt_n;
   130	            end
   131	        end
   132	    end
   133	
   134	    always_ff @(posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni) begin
   135	        if(~rst_ni) begin
   136	            mem_q <= {FifoDepth{dtype'('0)}};
   137	        end else if (!gate_clock) begin
   138	            mem_q <= mem_n;
   139	        end
   140	    end
   141	
   142	`ifndef COMMON_CELLS_ASSERTS_OFF
   143	    `ASSERT_INIT(depth_0, DEPTH > 0, "DEPTH must be greater than 0.")
   144	
   145	    `ASSERT(full_write, full_o |-> ~push_i, clk_i, !rst_ni,
   146	            "Trying to push new data although the FIFO is full.")
   147	
   148	    `ASSERT(empty_read, empty_o |-> ~pop_i, clk_i, !rst_ni,
   149	            "Trying to pop data although the FIFO is empty.")
   150	`endif

    14	// Description: logarithmic arbitration tree with round robin arbitration scheme.

    16	`include "common_cells/assertions.svh"

    18	/// The rr_arb_tree employs non-starving round robin-arbitration - i.e., the priorities
    19	/// rotate each cycle.
    20	///
    21	/// ## Fair vs. unfair Arbitration
    22	///
    23	/// This refers to fair throughput distribution when not all inputs have active requests.
    24	/// This module has an internal state `rr_q` which defines the highest priority input. (When
    25	/// `ExtPrio` is `1'b1` this state is provided from the outside.) The arbitration tree will
    26	/// choose the input with the same index as currently defined by the state if it has an active
    27	/// request. Otherwise a *random* other active input is selected. The parameter `FairArb` is used
    28	/// to distinguish between two methods of calculating the next state.
    29	/// * `1'b0`: The next state is calculated by advancing the current state by one. This leads to the
    30	///           state being calculated without the context of the active request. Leading to an
    31	///           unfair throughput distribution if not all inputs have active requests.
    32	/// * `1'b1`: The next state jumps to the next unserved request with higher index.
    33	///           This is achieved by using two trailing-zero-counters (`lzc`). The upper has the masked
    34	///           `req_i` signal with all indices which will have a higher priority in the next state.
    35	///           The trailing zero count defines the input index with the next highest priority after
    36	///           the current one is served. When the upper is empty the lower `lzc` provides the
    37	///           wrapped index if there are outstanding requests with lower or same priority.
    38	/// The implication of throughput fairness on the module timing are:
    39	/// * The trailing zero counter (`lzc`) has a loglog relation of input to output timing. This means
    40	///   that in this module the input to register path scales with Log(Log(`NumIn`)).
    41	/// * The `rr_arb_tree` data multiplexing scales with Log(`NumIn`). This means that the input to output
    42	///   timing path of this module also scales scales with Log(`NumIn`).
    43	/// This implies that in this module the input to output path is always longer than the input to
    44	/// register path. As the output data usually also terminates in a register the parameter `FairArb`
    45	/// only has implications on the area. When it is `1'b0` a static plus one adder is instantiated.
    46	/// If it is `1'b1` two `lzc`, a masking logic stage and a two input multiplexer are instantiated.
    47	/// However these are small in respect of the data multiplexers needed, as the width of the `req_i`
    48	/// signal is usually less as than `DataWidth`.
    49	module rr_arb_tree #(
    50	  /// Number of inputs to be arbitrated.
    51	  parameter int unsigned NumIn      = 64,
    52	  /// Data width of the payload in bits. Not needed if `DataType` is overwritten.
    53	  parameter int unsigned DataWidth  = 32,
    54	  /// Data type of the payload, can be overwritten with custom type. Only use of `DataWidth`.
    55	  parameter type         DataType   = logic [DataWidth-1:0],
    56	  /// The `ExtPrio` option allows to override the internal round robin counter via the
    57	  /// `rr_i` signal. This can be useful in case multiple arbiters need to have
    58	  /// rotating priorities that are operating in lock-step. If static priority arbitration
    59	  /// is needed, just connect `rr_i` to '0.
    60	  ///
    61	  /// Set to 1'b1 to enable.
    62	  parameter bit          ExtPrio    = 1'b0,
    63	  /// If `AxiVldRdy` is set, the req/gnt signals are compliant with the AXI style vld/rdy
    64	  /// handshake. Namely, upstream vld (req) must not depend on rdy (gnt), as it can be deasserted
    65	  /// again even though vld is asserted. Enabling `AxiVldRdy` leads to a reduction of arbiter
    66	  /// delay and area.
    67	  ///
    68	  /// Set to `1'b1` to treat req/gnt as vld/rdy.
    69	  parameter bit          AxiVldRdy  = 1'b0,
    70	  /// The `LockIn` option prevents the arbiter from changing the arbitration
    71	  /// decision when the arbiter is disabled. I.e., the index of the first request
    72	  /// that wins the arbitration will be locked in case the destination is not
    73	  /// able to grant the request in the same cycle.
    74	  ///
    75	  /// Set to `1'b1` to enable.
    76	  parameter bit          LockIn     = 1'b0,
    77	  /// When set, ensures that throughput gets distributed evenly between all inputs.
    78	  ///
    79	  /// Set to `1'b0` to disable.
    80	  parameter bit          FairArb    = 1'b1,
    81	  /// Dependent parameter, do **not** overwrite.
    82	  /// Width of the arbitration priority signal and the arbitrated index.
    83	  parameter int unsigned IdxWidth   = (NumIn > 32'd1) ? unsigned'($clog2(NumIn)) : 32'd1,
    84	  /// Dependent parameter, do **not** overwrite.
    85	  /// Type for defining the arbitration priority and arbitrated index signal.
    86	  parameter type         idx_t      = logic [IdxWidth-1:0]
    87	) (
    88	  /// Clock, positive edge triggered.
    89	  input  logic                clk_i,
    90	  /// Asynchronous reset, active low.
    91	  input  logic                rst_ni,
    92	  /// Clears the arbiter state. Only used if `ExtPrio` is `1'b0` or `LockIn` is `1'b1`.
    93	  input  logic                flush_i,
    94	  /// External round-robin priority. Only used if `ExtPrio` is `1'b1.`
    95	  input  idx_t                rr_i,
    96	  /// Input requests arbitration.
    97	  input  logic    [NumIn-1:0] req_i,
    98	  /* verilator lint_off UNOPTFLAT */
    99	  /// Input request is granted.
   100	  output logic    [NumIn-1:0] gnt_o,
   101	  /* verilator lint_on UNOPTFLAT */
   102	  /// Input data for arbitration.
   103	  input  DataType [NumIn-1:0] data_i,
   104	  /// Output request is valid.
   105	  output logic                req_o,
   106	  /// Output request is granted.
   107	  input  logic                gnt_i,
   108	  /// Output data.
   109	  output DataType             data_o,
   110	  /// Index from which input the data came from.
   111	  output idx_t                idx_o
   112	);
   113	
   114	  // just pass through in this corner case
   115	  if (NumIn == unsigned'(1)) begin : gen_pass_through
   116	    assign req_o    = req_i[0];
   117	    assign gnt_o[0] = gnt_i;
   118	    assign data_o   = data_i[0];
   119	    assign idx_o    = '0;
   120	  // non-degenerate cases
   121	  end else begin : gen_arbiter
   122	    localparam int unsigned NumLevels = unsigned'($clog2(NumIn));
   123	
   124	    /* verilator lint_off SPLITVAR */  // disable warning that is issued if bitwidth is 1
   125	    idx_t    [2**NumLevels-2:0] index_nodes /* verilator split_var */; // propagates indices
   126	    DataType [2**NumLevels-2:0] data_nodes  /* verilator split_var */; // propagates data
   127	    logic    [2**NumLevels-2:0] gnt_nodes   /* verilator split_var */; // propagates gnt to masters
   128	    logic    [2**NumLevels-2:0] req_nodes   /* verilator split_var */; // propagates reqs to slave
   129	    /* verilator lint_on SPLITVAR */
   130	
   131	    /* lint_off */
   132	    idx_t                       rr_q;
   133	    logic [NumIn-1:0]           req_d;
   134	
   135	    // the final arbitration decision can be taken from the root of the tree
   136	    assign req_o        = req_nodes[0];
   137	    assign data_o       = data_nodes[0];
   138	    assign idx_o        = index_nodes[0];
   139	
   140	    if (ExtPrio) begin : gen_ext_rr
   141	      assign rr_q       = rr_i;
   142	      assign req_d      = req_i;
   143	    end else begin : gen_int_rr
   144	      idx_t rr_d;
   145	
   146	      // lock arbiter decision in case we got at least one req and no acknowledge
   147	      if (LockIn) begin : gen_lock
   148	        logic  lock_d, lock_q;
   149	        logic [NumIn-1:0] req_q;
   150	
   151	        assign lock_d     = req_o & ~gnt_i;
   152	        assign req_d      = (lock_q) ? req_q : req_i;
   153	
   154	        always_ff @(posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni) begin : p_lock_reg
   155	          if (!rst_ni) begin
   156	            lock_q <= '0;
   157	          end else begin
   158	            if (flush_i) begin
   159	              lock_q <= '0;
   160	            end else begin
   161	              lock_q <= lock_d;
   162	            end
   163	          end
   164	        end
   165	
   166	        `ifndef COMMON_CELLS_ASSERTS_OFF
   167	          `ASSERT(lock, req_o && (!gnt_i && !flush_i) |=> idx_o == $past(idx_o),
   168	                  clk_i, !rst_ni || flush_i,
   169	                  "Lock implies same arbiter decision in next cycle if output is not ready.")
   170	
   171	          logic [NumIn-1:0] req_tmp;
   172	          assign req_tmp = req_q & req_i;
   173	          `ASSUME(lock_req, lock_d |=> req_tmp == req_q, clk_i, !rst_ni || flush_i,
   174	                  "It is disallowed to deassert unserved request signals when LockIn is enabled.")
   175	        `endif
   176	
   177	        always_ff @(posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni) begin : p_req_regs
   178	          if (!rst_ni) begin
   179	            req_q  <= '0;
   180	          end else begin
   181	            if (flush_i) begin
   182	              req_q  <= '0;
   183	            end else begin
   184	              req_q  <= req_d;
   185	            end
   186	          end
   187	        end
   188	      end else begin : gen_no_lock
   189	        assign req_d = req_i;
   190	      end
   191	
   192	      if (FairArb) begin : gen_fair_arb
   193	        logic [NumIn-1:0] upper_mask,  lower_mask;
   194	        idx_t             upper_idx,   lower_idx,   next_idx;
   195	        logic             upper_empty, lower_empty;
   196	
   197	        for (genvar i = 0; i < NumIn; i++) begin : gen_mask
   198	          assign upper_mask[i] = (i >  rr_q) ? req_d[i] : 1'b0;
   199	          assign lower_mask[i] = (i <= rr_q) ? req_d[i] : 1'b0;
   200	        end
   201	
   202	        lzc #(
   203	          .WIDTH ( NumIn ),
   204	          .MODE  ( 1'b0  )
   205	        ) i_lzc_upper (
   206	          .in_i    ( upper_mask  ),
   207	          .cnt_o   ( upper_idx   ),
   208	          .empty_o ( upper_empty )
   209	        );
   210	
   211	        lzc #(
   212	          .WIDTH ( NumIn ),
   213	          .MODE  ( 1'b0  )
   214	        ) i_lzc_lower (
   215	          .in_i    ( lower_mask  ),
   216	          .cnt_o   ( lower_idx   ),
   217	          .empty_o ( /*unused*/  )
   218	        );
   219	
   220	        assign next_idx = upper_empty      ? lower_idx : upper_idx;
   221	        assign rr_d     = (gnt_i && req_o) ? next_idx  : rr_q;
   222	
   223	      end else begin : gen_unfair_arb
   224	        assign rr_d = (gnt_i && req_o) ? ((rr_q == idx_t'(NumIn-1)) ? '0 : rr_q + 1'b1) : rr_q;
   225	      end
   226	
   227	      // this holds the highest priority
   228	      always_ff @(posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni) begin : p_rr_regs
   229	        if (!rst_ni) begin
   230	          rr_q   <= '0;
   231	        end else begin
   232	          if (flush_i) begin
   233	            rr_q   <= '0;
   234	          end else begin
   235	            rr_q   <= rr_d;
   236	          end
   237	        end
   238	      end
   239	    end
   240	
   241	    assign gnt_nodes[0] = gnt_i;
   242	
   243	    // arbiter tree
   244	    for (genvar level = 0; unsigned'(level) < NumLevels; level++) begin : gen_levels
   245	      for (genvar l = 0; l < 2**level; l++) begin : gen_level
   246	        // local select signal
   247	        logic sel;
   248	        // index calcs
   249	        localparam int unsigned Idx0 = 2**level-1+l;// current node
   250	        localparam int unsigned Idx1 = 2**(level+1)-1+l*2;
   251	        //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   252	        // uppermost level where data is fed in from the inputs
   253	        if (unsigned'(level) == NumLevels-1) begin : gen_first_level
   254	          // if two successive indices are still in the vector...
   255	          if (unsigned'(l) * 2 < NumIn-1) begin : gen_reduce
   256	            assign req_nodes[Idx0]   = req_d[l*2] | req_d[l*2+1];
   257	
   258	            // arbitration: round robin
   259	            assign sel =  ~req_d[l*2] | req_d[l*2+1] & rr_q[NumLevels-1-level];
   260	
   261	            assign index_nodes[Idx0] = idx_t'(sel);
   262	            assign data_nodes[Idx0]  = (sel) ? data_i[l*2+1] : data_i[l*2];
   263	            assign gnt_o[l*2]        = gnt_nodes[Idx0] & (AxiVldRdy | req_d[l*2])   & ~sel;
   264	            assign gnt_o[l*2+1]      = gnt_nodes[Idx0] & (AxiVldRdy | req_d[l*2+1]) & sel;
   265	          end
   266	          // if only the first index is still in the vector...
   267	          if (unsigned'(l) * 2 == NumIn-1) begin : gen_first
   268	            assign req_nodes[Idx0]   = req_d[l*2];
   269	            assign index_nodes[Idx0] = '0;// always zero in this case
   270	            assign data_nodes[Idx0]  = data_i[l*2];
   271	            assign gnt_o[l*2]        = gnt_nodes[Idx0] & (AxiVldRdy | req_d[l*2]);
   272	          end
   273	          // if index is out of range, fill up with zeros (will get pruned)
   274	          if (unsigned'(l) * 2 > NumIn-1) begin : gen_out_of_range
   275	            assign req_nodes[Idx0]   = 1'b0;
   276	            assign index_nodes[Idx0] = idx_t'('0);
   277	            assign data_nodes[Idx0]  = DataType'('0);
   278	          end
   279	        //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   280	        // general case for other levels within the tree
   281	        end else begin : gen_other_levels
   282	          assign req_nodes[Idx0]   = req_nodes[Idx1] | req_nodes[Idx1+1];
   283	
   284	          // arbitration: round robin
   285	          assign sel =  ~req_nodes[Idx1] | req_nodes[Idx1+1] & rr_q[NumLevels-1-level];
   286	
   287	          assign index_nodes[Idx0] = (sel) ?
   288	            idx_t'({1'b1, index_nodes[Idx1+1][NumLevels-unsigned'(level)-2:0]}) :
   289	            idx_t'({1'b0, index_nodes[Idx1][NumLevels-unsigned'(level)-2:0]});
   290	
   291	          assign data_nodes[Idx0]  = (sel) ? data_nodes[Idx1+1] : data_nodes[Idx1];
   292	          assign gnt_nodes[Idx1]   = gnt_nodes[Idx0] & ~sel;
   293	          assign gnt_nodes[Idx1+1] = gnt_nodes[Idx0] & sel;
   294	        end
   295	        //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   296	      end
   297	    end
   298	
   299	    `ifndef COMMON_CELLS_ASSERTS_OFF
   300	    `ASSERT_INIT(numin_0, NumIn, "Input must be at least one element wide.")
   301	    `ASSERT_INIT(lockin_and_extprio, !(LockIn && ExtPrio),
   302	                 "Cannot use LockIn feature together with external ExtPrio.")
   303	
   304	    `ASSERT(hot_one, $onehot0(gnt_o), clk_i, !rst_ni || flush_i,
   305	            "Grant signal must be hot1 or zero.")
   306	
   307	    `ASSERT(gnt0, |gnt_o |-> gnt_i, clk_i, !rst_ni || flush_i, "Grant out implies grant in.")
   308	
   309	    `ASSERT(gnt1, req_o |-> gnt_i |-> |gnt_o, clk_i, !rst_ni || flush_i,
